subject: Scheduling: Umbratek CAIQ walkthrough & log/sample transfer

Cc: Veritas Audit <audit@veritas-audit.com>

Subject: CAIQ walkthrough & sample log transfer - Redwood

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking this on. We're starting the vendor intake for Redwood and want to run through the CAIQ (~30-45 minutes) so our security team can validate coverage and flag any follow-ups. A few quick asks so we can prep on our side: 

- Can you share 2–3 available windows this week for a 45-minute session? We prefer mornings Pacific.
- What log types and retention windows do you typically provide sample extracts for SIG/CAIQ review (auth logs, admin activity, object storage access, etc.)? Any max file size limits to note?
- Is a SOC 2 Type II report available or in progress? If yes, can we get an expected delivery timeframe?

I'll loop in our security lead Alicia (cc'd) and our external auditor from Veritas (cc'd) so they can join if helpful. We've attached an early draft of our internal asset mapping for reference (umbratek-sig-draft.xlsx).

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we'll aim to book once we get your slot options.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Head of IT Security
Umbratek, Inc.

Attachments: umbratek-sig-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@umbratek.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Veritas Audit <audit@veritas-audit.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ walkthrough & sample log transfer - Redwood

Hi Samir — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the draft asset map. 

We can do a 45-minute CAIQ review this week. Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 4/14 09:00–09:45
- Wed 4/14 11:00–11:45
- Thu 4/15 08:30–09:15

We typically provide the following sample extracts to customers/auditors for questionnaire validation:
- Auth logs (successful/failed auths) — 30 days sample
- Admin / infra activity logs (console/API operations) — 14–30 days sample depending on the subsystem
- Object storage access logs (signed URL, object GET/PUT) — 14 days sample
- Application request traces (anonymized request ids + timestamps) — 7–14 days

File size guidance: prefer uploads under 500MB per file; if you need larger transfers we can provide SFTP and a short-lived upload folder.

SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II in progress; expected completion Q3 2027. We can provide the latest readiness summary in advance of the call.

I've attached our internal upload/runbook with instructions for generating and packaging log extracts (redwood_log_sample_instructions.md). Ben Carter (security operations) is on cc and will share the SFTP details and the upload window once you confirm a slot.

If one of those times doesn't work, tell us preferred times and we'll adjust.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Architect — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks Samir — confirmed for Wed 4/14 11:00–11:45 PT.

SFTP details (temporary upload area):
- Host: sftp.redwood-upload.com
- Port: 2222
- Username: umbratek_upload
- Password: (will send via separate message at T-24h)
- Path: /incoming/umbratek/20270414/
- Retention: files kept 14 days then purged

Runbook highlights (see redwood_log_sample_instructions.md for full steps):
1) Please redact user PII where not strictly necessary (we can advise on fields).
2) Tar + gzip logs and name files as <logtype>_<startYYYYMMDD>_<endYYYYMMDD>.gz.
3) If any file exceeds 500MB, split into chunks (split -b 450M).
4) Notify this thread once upload completes; we'll confirm receipt and checksum.

Attendees on our side for the call: Ben Carter (Security Ops), Jasmine Liu (Solutions), Marissa Cole (Compliance Manager). Expect a short preface (5–7m) on how we map CAIQ answers to artifacts, then review of your submitted CAIQ and the logs. We'll capture action items in a shared doc and follow up within 48 hours with any evidence requests.

Action items before Wed 4/14:
- Umbratek: upload 14-day admin + storage access logs to SFTP (Samir/Alicia).
- Redwood: send SOC 2 readiness summary and a shared doc link for action items (Jasmine).

Ben Carter
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
